title: Kid vs Dad 06 voice probe
tool: voice probe: makes and measures the line takes, never a video

do.line: Swallowed. Don't move. Don't make a sound.
do.style: frozen, deadly serious, a bomb-squad whisper, one word at a time

do.line: Swallowed... is it deadly? Stay down.
do.style: tense, crouched, a war correspondent under cover

do.line: We're live. Tato, age seven, swallowed his gum.
do.style: grave, low, a correspondent under cover

do.line: In this house, one rule: your stomach glues shut... for seven years. Not a crumb.
do.style: slow, ominous, a pause before the last words

do.line: One minute to dinner. If it's glued... it stays out.
do.style: grim, setting the egg timer, a man defusing a bomb

do.line: Mitts.
do.style: short, a surgeon asking for a tool

do.line: It's sticking. No doubt.
do.style: horrified whisper, ear on the glass

do.line: Sir... that was your stomach, I'm sure.
do.style: suspicious, slow, mic pushed in

do.line: Mine is fine. Mine is secure.
do.style: too quick, too calm, a lie

do.line: Helmet.
do.style: short, grim, pulling it on

do.line: Red wire... or blue? Which one's the clue?
do.style: sweating, tongs hovering over the sweater

do.line: It's my sweater. It's new.
do.style: flat, bored, lying on the table

do.line: Want one?
do.style: innocent, holding out a gum

do.line: Get that away! Don't you come near!
do.style: panicked, jumping back as if from a snake

do.line: He's been through this before, I fear.
do.style: quiet, knowing, to the camera

do.line: Full armour. The moment of truth. One bite.
do.style: hushed, tense, the countdown

do.line: Slowly... slowly... hold on tight.
do.style: trembling, behind the pot-lid shield

do.line: Still works. Not glued. Not stuck.
do.style: flat, after a burp, unimpressed

do.line: Impossible. Just beginner's luck.
do.style: stunned, lowering the shield

do.line: Then what... is this? Dad, ninety-five.
do.style: slow, holding up an X-ray, a reporter with proof

do.line: ...That's different. I survived.
do.style: a dry swallow, sweating, caught

notes: Voice probe for Kid vs Dad 06: makes and measures every take. rep stands in as Spud's body; its voice is reaper.
